lib.arende.allaStyrkta:
Every sentence with a reference is supported by the source it points to, and
  every number in the answers is in the material. The check is word-based and can
  be wrong — but it cannot flatter.
lib.arende.brist.felNr: · Question {i}: reference [{nr}] points to a source that does not exist

lib.arende.brist.tal.en: · Question {i}: {n} number is in the answer but not in the material
lib.arende.brist.tal.flera: · Question {i}: {n} numbers are in the answer but not in the material

lib.arende.brist.talLista: {tal} — these were not calculated by MAXIMUS.
lib.arende.brist.utanStod: · Question {i}: reference [{nr}] lacks support in the source
lib.arende.hogstaKlass: Highest information class in the case: {niva}{skal}.
lib.arende.ingenting: Nothing. All work happened on this computer.
lib.arende.lamnat: WHAT HAS LEFT THE COMPUTER IN THIS CASE
lib.arende.lasIKallan: Read these in the source before they are used.
lib.arende.om:
The answers are written by a language model. A language model can be wrong, even when
it sounds certain, and it replaces no legal or medical judgment.
The brief is meant to be read together with the sources, not instead of
them. The section "What could not be substantiated" further down shows where
the brief is thin.

lib.arende.paborjades.en: The conversation started {dag} and has {n} question.
lib.arende.paborjades.flera: The conversation started {dag} and has {n} questions.

lib.funktioner.agent.gor: How the agent works: how often it looks, what it reads in email, calendar and notes, which tasks use it, and what it never does.
lib.funktioner.bevakning.gor: The deadlines, and the legal provisions your answers rest on — with what is new.
lib.funktioner.bevakning.kostar: Only the provision leaves the computer when it is checked.
lib.funktioner.djupdykning.gor: A deep dive before a meeting or event: the sources, the people, the situation with sources, a file per person, A and B list, how to approach, pitches and a three-step plan — fact-checked against your "safe to say" file. Write the brief after the command.
lib.funktioner.djupdykning.kostar: Takes a while and runs in the background. Public figures from a public source are searched by name; your mandate weighs the routing as usual.
lib.funktioner.djupsok.gor: Several rounds on the web, each round on the previous round's gaps.
lib.funktioner.djupsok.kostar: Several search queries leave the computer, all logged. Takes longer.
lib.funktioner.dokument.gor: The same as a Word document: outline, sections with sources as footnotes, table of contents and review.
lib.funktioner.dokumentIn.gor: PDF, Word, RTF, ODT and images are read out as text, and you ask about it.
lib.funktioner.dokumentIn.kostar: Read on the computer. Nothing leaves it.
lib.funktioner.epost.gor: Reads subject lines and the week's meetings once you have given permission. A reply can open as a draft in Mail.
lib.funktioner.epost.kostar: Never writes and never sends. You press send.
lib.funktioner.fil.gor: Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint or Markdown from an answer — the draft if there is one.
lib.funktioner.fil.kostar: Written on the computer, encrypted if Maximus has a password.
lib.funktioner.fil.skriv: Make a file of the answer
lib.funktioner.fraga.gor: The answer is written by the model on your computer. Names and details can stay as they are — they stay here.
lib.funktioner.fynd.gor: Everything the agent has found, what it set aside and why, and what the latest run did. "Look now" runs one round.
lib.funktioner.fynd.kostar: Reads on the computer. A run on a page fetches it, and that is logged.
lib.funktioner.help.gor: Everything Maximus can do, in four groups. Type just / and the commands unfold.
lib.funktioner.inspelning.gor: The audio is transcribed by the listening model and joined into sentences.
lib.funktioner.inspelning.kostar: Runs on the computer. Takes a while for long recordings.
lib.funktioner.installningar.gor: Opens the settings: model, password, masking, rules.
lib.funktioner.kalender.gor: The meetings in the next seven days. A meeting you pick opens as a conversation.
lib.funktioner.kalender.kostar: Reads the week. Asks for permission the first time. Never changes anything.
lib.funktioner.kalkylblad.gor: xlsx, ods and csv are read as tables; sum, average, median, min and max are calculated per column.
lib.funktioner.kalkylblad.kostar: Calculated on the computer, not by the model.
lib.funktioner.lagandringar.gor: Follows the legal provisions your answers rested on and tells you when a section changes or a deadline approaches.
lib.funktioner.lagandringar.kostar: Only the provision leaves the computer — never the question, never the case.
lib.funktioner.las.gor: Locks a conversation with a code, seals it (forgotten code = gone), or shares it as an encrypted file — Share… opens the Mac's share menu: Mail, Messages, AirDrop and whatever you have installed.
lib.funktioner.las.kostar: A shared file leaves the computer when you send it. The code is the whole protection.
lib.funktioner.maskering.gor: Chosen at the send button. Masked replaces names, personal ID numbers, addresses, phone and account numbers with placeholders; anonymized also rewrites what points someone out without a name.
lib.funktioner.maskering.kostar: Done on the computer. It is what goes out, if anything goes out.
lib.funktioner.post.gor: The latest subject lines in your email. A message you pick opens as a conversation, masked like all other material.
lib.funktioner.post.kostar: Reads subject lines only. Asks for permission the first time. Never sends.
lib.funktioner.presentation.gor: Makes a presentation to hand over: goal, audience and length → an outline you approve → each slide written with sources → review → a PowerPoint with speaker notes and a slide with the sources.
lib.funktioner.presentation.kostar: Written on the computer. The web only when the routing says the material can take it, and every lookup is logged.
lib.funktioner.projekt.gor: Gathers conversations under a goal, so that a new conversation can read what was said in the earlier ones.
lib.funktioner.rensa.gor: Deletes all conversations, projects, tasks, finds and deadlines. Asks first.
lib.funktioner.rensa.kostar: Cannot be undone. The ledger remains.
lib.funktioner.rundtur.gor: A short tour: five things Maximus can do, with examples made from your profile and what you have allowed. Stop whenever you like; the example you pick goes into the box, and is only sent when you press.
lib.funktioner.skickat.gor: The ledger: every payload that has left the computer, line by line, hash-chained. Can be exported.
lib.funktioner.skickat.kostar: Nothing. It cannot be emptied from the app.
lib.funktioner.spela.gor: Records a meeting. It is transcribed in five-minute chunks while it runs, and when you stop, the transcript becomes a document that Maximus summarizes: what was said, what was decided, who does what. Same as "Record a meeting" under plus and ⌘⇧R. The microphone by the box dictates instead.
lib.funktioner.spela.kostar: Recorded and transcribed on the computer. The audio is not saved, only the text.
lib.funktioner.uppdrag.gor: Without text: your tasks. With text — what I should keep an eye on — a new task, and I ask where to look.
lib.funktioner.uppdrag.kostar: Run by the agent on the computer.
lib.funktioner.webbsok.gor: Looks up what requires a fact no model can have, and reports the sources with numbers and credibility.
lib.funktioner.webbsok.kostar: A masked search query leaves the computer and is logged in the ledger. Sensitive questions are shown to you first.
lib.funktioner.zoom.gor: Makes the whole app bigger, smaller, or as before.
lib.grader.paket.allt.om: Every kind on. The answer gets worse — a model not allowed to see a date cannot count days — but nothing can slip through.
lib.grader.paket.myndighet.om: Standard plus case reference numbers and links. For anyone handling cases that can be requested under public access rules.
lib.grader.paket.sakerhet.om: Hides the infrastructure: host names, addresses, paths and keys. The names of people are rarely the sensitive part of an incident.
lib.grader.paket.standard.om: Personal data and contact details. Legal provisions, amounts and dates remain so the answer is usable.
lib.grader.paket.upphandling.om: Hides bid amounts and suppliers. The case reference number remains, since it is rarely secret and often necessary.
lib.grader.sort.belopp.om: Sums in kronor, euros and dollars
lib.grader.sort.datum.om: Makes the timeline unusable — use with judgment
lib.grader.sort.epost.om: The whole address, not just the domain
lib.grader.sort.namn.om: First names from name registers, surnames, nicknames
lib.grader.sort.organisationsnummer.om: And ID numbers of the same form
lib.grader.sort.personnummer.om: Also coordination numbers and mistyped ones
lib.grader.sort.sokvag.om: File paths and resources that reveal structure
lib.handlingar.anteckning.om: Writes a new note in the folder you pointed out in Notes.
lib.handlingar.beskriv.genvagIndata: Run the shortcut "{namn}" with the text below as input
lib.handlingar.beskriv.mejlutkast: Email draft: "{amne}" — put in Drafts, not sent
lib.handlingar.beskriv.mejlutkastTill: Email draft to {till}: "{amne}" — put in Drafts, not sent
lib.handlingar.fel.angra: This cannot be undone from here.
lib.handlingar.fel.moteBakat: The meeting is in the past. Which day do you mean?
lib.handlingar.fel.moteSlut: The meeting ends before it starts.
lib.handlingar.fel.moteStart: The meeting needs a start time.
lib.handlingar.fel.mottagare: The recipient is not an email address.
lib.handlingar.fel.passerat: That time has already passed. Which day do you mean?
lib.handlingar.fel.utkast: The draft needs a subject and text.
lib.handlingar.genvag.om: Runs one of your shortcuts in the Shortcuts app, with a text as input.
lib.handlingar.mejlutkast.namn: Put an email draft in Drafts
lib.handlingar.mejlutkast.om: Puts a draft in Mail under Drafts. Never sent by Maximus.
lib.handlingar.mote.om: Adds a meeting to the calendar.
lib.kedja.enFraga: read the question as one question
lib.kedja.forLangt: the conversation is longer than the model's memory — the oldest questions did not go along
lib.kedja.franBorjan: read the conversation from the start, {skickade} tokens
lib.kedja.gickMaskerad: the question went masked to {m}, the answer was restored here
lib.kedja.ingetMer: read the question, nothing more to hide
lib.kedja.klippt: the material was longer than the model's memory — the middle was cut, the beginning and end went along
lib.kedja.nyaTokens: read {nytt} new tokens — {cachade} of {skickade} were still there from the previous question
lib.kedja.omstart: the model restarted and the question was asked again
lib.kedja.prompt.baraDelen: Now answer only this part, without repeating what you have already written:
lib.kedja.prompt.idelar: You have worked through it in parts:
lib.kedja.prompt.redanBesvarad: If this part is already answered above: write ONE line saying so and stop there. No summary, no bold line, no rephrasing.
lib.kedja.sammandrag: the oldest questions went along as a summary, not word for word
lib.kedja.steg.fardig: Combining it into a finished text
lib.kedja.steg.laddar: The model restarted — bringing it back
lib.kedja.steg.maskera: Looking for details that must not leave the computer
lib.kedja.steg.planerar: Checking whether the question contains several questions
lib.kedja.steg.tolka: Reading the question for details that do not look like names
lib.kedja.styckenValda: {namn}: {stycken} of {av} passages chosen for the question
lib.kedja.tolkningInteIgang: Interpretation is not running on this computer. The question is masked by the rules, as usual.
lib.kedja.tolkningSvaradeInte: Interpretation did not respond ({fel}). The question is masked by the rules, as usual.
lib.liggare.fel.tomDag: the day file has neither rows nor a list
lib.liggare.format.csv: Opens in spreadsheet programs. Semicolons and UTF-8 with BOM.
lib.liggare.format.json: For systems that will read it further. The columns are explained in the file.
lib.liggare.format.txt: Plain text. Survives longest — no program needed.
lib.liggare.forseglat: [sealed session — the content requires the session's code]
lib.liggare.json.anmarkning: The text stands as it was written. In the CSV extract, cells starting with = + - @ are preceded by an apostrophe, so that spreadsheet programs read them as text.
lib.liggare.json.om: Extract from the MAXIMUS ledger — every payload that has left the organization.
lib.liggare.text.skrivNed: Write down the head somewhere off the computer. Only then can the chain not be silently recalculated.
lib.liggare.text.varjePost: Each entry below is a payload that has left the organization.
lib.liggare.text.varning: WARNING: the chain does not add up — {brott} breaks, {olasliga} unreadable days.
lib.liggarkedja.borta: points to {dag}, which does not exist and was not pruned
lib.liggarkedja.saknadLank: the day does not point back, but {dag} exists before it
lib.modeller.12b.matt: Judgment bench: zero remarks on ten answers.
lib.modeller.12b.om: The one MAXIMUS is tested on. Judges sensitive cases correctly and writes prose that holds up.
lib.modeller.12b.varfor: The one MAXIMUS is built and measured on. Judges sensitive cases correctly, writes prose that holds up, and is the one the instructions are tested against (in Swedish).
lib.modeller.26b.om: Twenty-six billion parameters, four active at a time. More knowledge without getting slower.
lib.modeller.26b.varfor: Twenty-six billion parameters but only four active at a time — more knowledge without getting slower. Not tested on the MAXIMUS bench.
lib.modeller.31b.om: Most capable, and noticeably slower — every word passes through the whole model.
lib.modeller.31b.varfor: Most knowledge, and noticeably slower: every word passes through the whole model. Not tested on the MAXIMUS bench.
lib.modeller.disk: There are {kvar} GB left on the disk and the model needs {behover}.
lib.modeller.e2b.om: The smallest model that still holds up for careful professional writing. Fast, short in its answers.
lib.modeller.e2b.varfor: The smallest that still holds up for careful professional writing (tested in Swedish). Short in its answers, fast on a computer without much memory to spare.
lib.modeller.e4b.matt: Judgment bench 2026-09-25: zero remarks on ten answers. The first run gave one — a bold verdict in a personal conversation — and it was solved with rules in lib/ton.mjs instead of a better instruction. The model was almost right; the rule makes it right.
lib.modeller.e4b.om: A good balance on an ordinary work computer. Handles reasoning and longer answers.
lib.modeller.e4b.varfor: Tested on the MAXIMUS judgment bench with no remarks. Handles reasoning and longer answers, and is about twice as fast as 12B on a computer with 16 GB.
lib.modeller.fel.http: The download failed: HTTP {status} from Hugging Face.
lib.modeller.fel.ingenBild: This model has no vision part.
lib.modeller.fel.storlek: {vad} came to {gjort} bytes, expected {byte}. The file was removed and nothing was saved.
lib.modeller.fel.storre: {vad} was larger than expected. Nothing was saved.
lib.modeller.fel.summa: {vad} has no checksum and will not be downloaded.
lib.modeller.fel.summaFel: {vad} does not match the Hugging Face checksum. The file was removed and nothing was saved.
lib.modeller.fel.utanfor: The model is outside the MAXIMUS folder and is left alone.
lib.modeller.llama31-8b.om: The most widespread open model in its class.
lib.modeller.llama31-8b.varfor: The most widespread open model of its size — a lot written about it if something goes wrong. Not tested by MAXIMUS.
lib.modeller.llama32-3b.om: Smallest of all. For computers with little memory.
lib.modeller.llama32-3b.varfor: The smallest option that keeps an argument together. Meta's own license, not Apache. Not tested by MAXIMUS.
lib.modeller.minne: The computer has {har} GB of memory. The smallest model wants {vill}.
lib.modeller.mistral-nemo.varfor: European provider, Apache 2.0, built with multilingual support as a goal. Not tested by MAXIMUS.
lib.modeller.mistral-small.varfor: European provider and open weights in a larger format. Wants plenty of memory. Not tested by MAXIMUS.
lib.modeller.qwen3-14b.om: Same class as MAXIMUS's own, another maker.
lib.modeller.qwen3-14b.varfor: The same size class as the one MAXIMUS is measured on, from another maker. Apache 2.0. Not tested by MAXIMUS.
lib.modeller.qwen3-32b.om: Largest that fits on a work computer.
lib.modeller.qwen3-32b.varfor: The largest open option that fits on a well-equipped work computer. Not tested by MAXIMUS.
lib.modeller.qwen3-4b.varfor: Open weights under Apache 2.0. Strong in several languages for its size. Not tested by MAXIMUS on public-sector cases.
lib.modeller.qwen3-8b.varfor: Apache 2.0 and broad multilingual support. A reasonable first choice for anyone who does not want to run Google. Not tested by MAXIMUS.
lib.plugins.angeUri: Give a uri from a search.
lib.plugins.angeUriEx: Give a uri from a search, e.g. https://lagen.nu/1977:1160.
lib.plugins.domstolsverket.om: The most recently published decisions from Swedish courts, with summary and judgment as PDF. Open data, no login.
lib.plugins.fel.enRad: {n} must be one line of text.
lib.plugins.fel.helSokvag: The folder must be a full path, for example ~/Documents/Cases.
lib.plugins.fel.https: The address must start with https://.
lib.plugins.fel.miljoObjekt: The environment must be an object.
lib.plugins.flerTraffar: [{kvar} more hits — search more narrowly if none of these fit]
lib.plugins.ingenLag: Found no statute with SFS number {sfs}.
lib.plugins.inteAn.allabolag: Blocks automated requests (HTTP 403). Requires their own API agreement.
lib.plugins.inteAn.bankid: Requires an RP certificate ordered through a bank, and mutual TLS. No MCP server exists.
lib.plugins.inteAn.bolagsverket: Has a free API for high-value datasets — organization names, addresses, SNI codes — but it requires a customer registration and OAuth credentials sent by email. Can be connected once you have them.
lib.plugins.inteAn.fortnox: The API requires a partner agreement. There are MCP servers that have done the work — connect them as a remote connection.
lib.plugins.inteAn.skatteverket: Open data exists, but what most people want requires authorization as a representative.
lib.plugins.inteAn.visma: OAuth per customer, with read scopes like ea:accounting_readonly. Remote connection once you have the credentials.
lib.plugins.ivo.om: Statistics from the Swedish Health and Social Care Inspectorate: lex Sarah, lex Maria, unimplemented decisions, complaints.
lib.plugins.kolada.om: Key figures for Swedish municipalities and regions. Open data, no login.
lib.plugins.lagen.licens: CC BY-SA 4.0 — the source must be shown
lib.plugins.lagen.om: The entire body of Swedish law: statutes, case law, preparatory works and agency regulations — with the references between them. Open data, no login.
lib.plugins.maskinutvunna: Machine-extracted by lagen.nu — check in the original before they are used.
lib.plugins.mcp.filer.om: Reads files in a folder you point out. Good for a case archive or a folder of material.
lib.plugins.mcp.fjarr.krav: The address of the service's MCP server. You log in with them, in your browser.
lib.plugins.mcp.fjarr.om: Connects to an MCP server running somewhere else and logs in with OAuth in the browser. The way to Google Drive, Slack, Atlassian and others that have their own service.
lib.plugins.mcp.notion.krav: An integration token from Notion, and the pages shared with the integration.
lib.plugins.mcp.notion.om: Reads pages and databases in Notion.
lib.plugins.mcp.webblasare.om: Controls a browser for pages that require login or clicks. Deep search uses its own — this is for what it cannot reach.
lib.plugins.riksdagen.om: Statutes, government bills, motions and committee reports from the Swedish Parliament. Open data, no login.
lib.plugins.scb.licens: Open data — cite SCB for unchanged figures
lib.plugins.scb.om: The statistical database of Statistics Sweden. Open data, no login.
lib.plugins.urval.del: lagen.nu sent only part of the document. Do not answer that a detail is missing from the law — say that you only received part of it.
lib.plugins.urval.kvar: MAXIMUS chose the parts relevant to the question. These chapters were NOT included: {kvar}.
lib.plugins.urval.saknas: If what was asked for is not below, you must not answer that it is missing from the law — say that it is not in the parts you have read, and that a section reference gives the provision directly.
lib.plugins.v.domar_senaste: The most recently published decisions from Swedish courts, newest first. Use lagen_sok to search case law — this tool answers "what has come out recently".
lib.plugins.v.ivo_databaser: Lists what is in the IVO statistics database. Without a path, the branches are shown; with a path, what is under it.
lib.plugins.v.kolada_nyckeltal: Searches key figures in Kolada by title. Titles are in Swedish, e.g. "kostnad" (cost) or "elever" (pupils).
lib.plugins.v.lagen_hamta: Fetches a document in full text from lagen.nu. Give the uri a search returned, e.g. https://lagen.nu/1977:1160. If the question concerns a specific provision, give lagrum — then only that section is fetched.
lib.plugins.v.lagen_hamta.lagrum: K3P1 for chapter 3 section 1, P6 for section 6 (optional)
lib.plugins.v.lagen_hamta.uri: the document's uri from a search
lib.plugins.v.lagen_hanvisningar: Shows what refers TO a provision — case law and preparatory works that have examined it. Answers "is there case law on this section".
lib.plugins.v.lagen_sok: Searches the entire body of Swedish law: statutory text, case law, preparatory works, agency regulations, decisions by the Parliamentary Ombudsmen (JO) and the Chancellor of Justice (JK). Use this before anything else when the question is about what applies. Search terms work best in Swedish.
lib.plugins.v.lagen_sok.sok: search text, e.g. "strandskydd dispens" (Swedish terms work best)
lib.plugins.v.riksdagen_lagtext: Fetches a Swedish statute in full text. Give the SFS number, e.g. 1977:1160 for the Work Environment Act.
lib.plugins.v.riksdagen_sok: Searches the documents of the Swedish Parliament. doktyp: sfs for statutory text, prop for government bills, bet for committee reports.
lib.plugins.v.scb_bladdra: Browses the Statistics Sweden database. Without a path, the subject areas are listed; with a path, what is under it is listed.
lib.tillstand.anteckningar.fraga: May I read a folder in Notes? You choose which one. I read only that one, and write a new note there only if you say yes to it. I never change what you have written.
lib.tillstand.anteckningar.ja: Notes on. I read the folder {mapp} and no other. I do not write in it without your yes, and never change what you have written.
lib.tillstand.anteckningar.nej: Notes off. I read no notes.
lib.tillstand.anteckningar.vad: reads a folder you point out
lib.tillstand.epost.fraga: May I read your email? I read the subject lines, and the text of the messages needed when you ask something or give me a task. I never send anything — a reply becomes at most a draft in Drafts, after your yes.
lib.tillstand.epost.ja: Email on. I read {lada} on {konto}. I never send — a reply becomes at most a draft that you send yourself.
lib.tillstand.epost.nej: Email off. I read no mail.
lib.tillstand.kalender.fraga: May I read your calendar? I read the meetings and never change a meeting. A new one is only added if you say yes to it.
lib.tillstand.kalender.ja: Calendar on. I read the meetings in all calendars and never change a meeting; a new one is only added after your yes.
lib.tillstand.kalender.nej: Calendar off. I read no meetings.
lib.tillstand.mapp.fraga: May I read a folder — for example Downloads or Documents? I see the most recently changed files and read the text in them, and never write in the folder.
lib.tillstand.mapp.ja: Folder on. I read the most recently changed files in {mapp}, and never write there.
lib.tillstand.mapp.nej: Folder off. I read no files.
lib.tillstand.mapp.vad: reads the files in a folder you choose, never writes
lib.tillstand.meddelanden.fraga: May I read your incoming messages (iMessage and SMS)? I read the latest ones, and never write or send. macOS requires you to give Maximus Full Disk Access for that.
lib.tillstand.meddelanden.ja: Messages on. I read the latest incoming messages, and never write or send.
lib.tillstand.meddelanden.nej: Messages off. I read no messages.
lib.tillstand.meddelanden.vad: reads incoming iMessage and SMS, never writes
lib.tillstand.paminnelser.fraga: May I read your reminders — the open ones, and the ones you checked off in the past week? I never change or check off anything, and a new one is only created after your yes. macOS asks you once.
lib.tillstand.paminnelser.ja: Reminders on. I read the open ones and the ones you checked off in the past week, and change nothing you have written.
lib.tillstand.paminnelser.nej: Reminders off. I read no reminders.
lib.tillstand.paminnelser.vad: reads your reminders, never checks them off
lib.tillstand.samtal.fraga: May I read the call history — who called, when and whether you missed it? The calls themselves are not there, only the list. macOS requires Full Disk Access for that.
lib.tillstand.samtal.ja: Call history on. I see who called, when, and whether the call was missed. Nothing else.
lib.tillstand.telefon.fraga: May your iPhone ping when something important happens and you are not at the computer? Like this: I put a reminder in the Reminders app, in a list of its own called Maximus. It syncs via iCloud to the phone, and the phone pings like for any reminder — with what it is about as text. And you reply the same way: check it off when you have seen it, or write in the note and I will read it. You can also add a reminder of your own to the Maximus list — or say "Hey Siri, add … to Maximus" — and I will take it as a message. No app and no account needed. At most four an hour, and I remove my reminders after a day.
lib.tillstand.telefon.ja: Phone on. When you are away from the computer and something important happens, your iPhone pings, via the Maximus reminder list. Reply by writing in the note, check it off when you have seen it. If you would rather have an iMessage, choose that under Settings → Agent → To your phone.
lib.tillstand.telefon.nej: Phone off. I tell you here, on the computer.
lib.tillstand.telefon.vad: so I can tell you when you are not here
lib.verktyg.avstangt: Turned off: you have not given the agent {vad}. It is turned on under Settings → Agent.
lib.verktyg.fel.adress: that address has not come from any tool. Search first, and read one of the hits.
lib.verktyg.fel.baraMappar: only files in the agent's folders.
lib.verktyg.fel.finnsInte: the file is not in the agent's folders.
lib.verktyg.fel.obevakad: without you at the computer, only hits from a search in the same run are read.
lib.verktyg.handling: {om} The user sees the suggestion and answers yes or no before anything is done.
lib.verktyg.ingenWebb: The web is not used here: {varfor}. Answer with what is on the computer.
lib.verktyg.om.anteckningar: The notes in the folder you gave the agent, filtered by a word.
lib.verktyg.om.genvagar: The names of the shortcuts in the Shortcuts app on this computer. (Running a shortcut is an action and requires your yes.)
lib.verktyg.om.kalender: The meetings in the calendar from today and a number of days ahead (or back with a negative number).
lib.verktyg.om.las_fil: Reads a whole file (PDF, Word, text, spreadsheet) in the folder you gave the agent. Give the file name.
lib.verktyg.om.las_sida: Reads a web page. Only an address that has already come from another tool (a search hit, a link in an email).
lib.verktyg.om.lediga_tider: Free slots in the calendar on weekdays between two times of day, at least a certain length.
lib.verktyg.om.mapp: The most recently changed files in the folder you gave the agent, with the start of the text.
lib.verktyg.om.meddelanden: The latest incoming messages (iMessage and SMS), filtered by a word or a sender.
lib.verktyg.om.mejl: The latest messages in the inbox: subject, sender, time and the start of the text. Most of what comes from outside is here — tenders, bids, quotes, invoices, deadlines, questions from colleagues. Can be filtered by a word or a sender.
lib.verktyg.om.paminnelser: Open reminders and the ones checked off in the past week.
lib.verktyg.om.rakna: Calculates on a list of numbers: sum, count, average, median, min and max. Calculate here instead of in your head.
lib.verktyg.om.safari_sida: The text of the page open in Safari right now (the front tab), for example a logged-in profile.
lib.verktyg.om.webbsok: Searches the web. Returns titles and addresses. The query is masked and logged before it leaves the computer.
lib.verktyg.param.dagar: How many days ahead, 1 = today and tomorrow
lib.verktyg.param.sok: Word or sender to filter by
lib.verktyg.rakna: sum {sum} · count {antal} · average {snitt} · median {med} · min {minsta} · max {storsta}
